summary: Miniflux is a minimalist news reader designed to aggregate web feeds in a clean interface. It allows you to subscribe to RSS and Atom sources and consume updates without unnecessary clutter or tracking.
goodFor: It suits self-hosters who want a lightweight, distraction-free reading environment running on their own infrastructure.
watchOut: Being a minimalist application, it lacks advanced content-curation workflows or complex social sharing features found in heavier alternatives.
deployNotes: You will typically deploy this via Docker or the provided deb package, ensuring you configure a persistent database backend and a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
